body:
Very good stuff for everyday use (which is what it´s intended for). Makes one feel alert but much better than coffee because it lasts all day. Gives you a good recalection of everything (good memory) and also gives a nice feeling of wellbeing. A normal supply is about 60 250mg pills which last about two months and it´s very inexpensive too. Only drawback is the feeling of mental weakness when you stop taking them after your supply has run out.
